description: Call this when the user asks how much it costs to file a request for review of their property assessment in Quebec. Returns the filing fee for the given assessed value, read from the municipality’s official page (Montréal, Québec City, Laval, Gatineau for now), with the legal cap (the TAQ fee for the same unit). Returns "not collected" instead of an estimate for other municipalities.

valeur.description: Assessed value on the roll in CAD (the value on the notice, not the market price).

name: frais_revision
title: Frais d'une demande de révision / Assessment review filing fee (Quebec)
